text: The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Boards of Management of two (2) Business Improvement Areas that fall within the Etobicoke York Community Council boundaries for the new term of Council and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area (BIA) Board of Management set out below at the pleasure of Etobicoke York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Weston Village: Ahmad, Atiq Anastasoff, David Hatherley, Marianne Hossain, Masum Kalamaris, George Kalamaris, Peter Makim, Paren Warsame, Omar Weinberg-Linsky, Suri 2. Directed that Schedule A of the Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas, be amended by changing the number of members of the following Board of Management: Weston Village 10 3.
